scenarios.name: Casting your second spell in a turn draws a card and creates a 0/3 Wall with defender
scenarios.ruling: "Whenever you cast your second spell each turn" is a triggered ability: it goes on the stack above the spell that triggered it and resolves first, drawing a card and then creating the token.

scenarios.name: Only the second spell of the turn triggers Rammas Echor, not the third
scenarios.ruling: The trigger condition is casting your second spell that turn, so casting three spells in one turn triggers it exactly once: one card drawn from the trigger and one Wall token.

scenarios.name: Defenders gain exalted at the beginning of combat, so a lone attacker gets +1/+1 for each of them
scenarios.ruling: Each instance of exalted among permanents you control triggers when a creature you control attacks alone and gives that creature +1/+1 until end of turn, so two exalted Walls make an attacking Grizzly Bears a 4/4 and it deals 4 damage.

scenarios.name: A creature without defender does not gain exalted from Rammas Echor
scenarios.ruling: The ability grants exalted only to the creatures you control that have defender as it resolves, so a Hill Giant you control adds no instance of exalted and the lone attacker gets only the +1/+1 from the single Wall.
